title: Remy's ratatouille
summary: Remy's signature dish: a rustic French stew of aubergine, courgette, peppers and tomato. Each veg is browned on its own, then everything comes together with garlic and basil.
source: Based on TheMealDB #52908 (from BBC Good Food), rewritten step by step for REMY with timers from cook-times.json. Waiting for Matthew's review.
equipment: Large sauté pan or deep frying pan
notes: Brown each vegetable separately: crowding the pan makes them steam instead of colour. Knife work: claw grip, board on a damp cloth.

steps.instruction: Cut the aubergines in half lengthways, then into 1.5cm chunks. Slice the courgettes into 1.5cm rounds. Cut the peppers around the stalk, remove the seeds and chop into bite-size pieces.
looks_right: claw grip, board steady on a damp cloth
looks_wrong: fingertips flat in front of the blade
steps.done_when: All the veg is chopped into even chunks.

steps.instruction: Score a small cross on the base of each tomato, cover with boiling water for about 20 seconds, then drain and cover with cold water. Peel off the skins, quarter them, scoop out the seeds and chop the flesh.
looks_wrong: boiling water splashing (pour slowly, away from you)
tomatoes left too long in hot water (mushy)
steps.done_when: The tomatoes are peeled, seeded and chopped.

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in the pan over medium heat. Brown the aubergine chunks for about 5 minutes on each side until golden and soft, then lift them out.
steps.done_when: The aubergine is golden and soft, set aside.

steps.instruction: Add another tbsp of oil and fry the courgettes for about 5 minutes until golden on both sides, then lift them out. Do the same with the peppers.
looks_right: peppers softening with a little colour
looks_wrong: veg going mushy (it cooks more later)
steps.done_when: Courgettes and peppers are golden and set aside.

steps.instruction: Cook the onion in the pan until soft, then add the garlic for about a minute. Stir in the vinegar and sugar, tip in the tomatoes and half the torn basil.
steps.done_when: A soft onion, garlic and tomato base.

steps.instruction: Put all the vegetables back in, season with salt and pepper, and let it bubble gently for about 5 minutes. Scatter over the rest of the basil and serve.
looks_right: veg coated in a glossy tomato sauce
looks_wrong: sauce catching and sticking (stir, heat down)
steps.done_when: Everything is hot, glossy and tender. Serve with basil on top.
